visual.general_description: Two-panel figure: a histogram of cumulative AmB-d dose for 19 patients (A) and a table of dose thresholds with patient counts (B).
visual.detailed_description: Panel A at left shows the dose histogram with a fitted curve and mean marker; panel B at right shows the threshold table with counts 1, 2, 9, 4 and 3 and cumulative percentages ending at 100%. Both panels are cohort-level summaries with no individual patient identifiers.

panels.general_description: Histogram of cumulative amphotericin B deoxycholate dose per kilogram for 19 patients with a red fitted bell curve and a dotted vertical line at the mean.
panels.detailed_description: Bold title Distribution of Amphotericin B Deoxycholate Doses (mg/kg) with the subtitle n = 19 patients. Light gray grid with light blue bars outlined in dark blue. The x axis is Cumulative Dose (mg/kg) with ticks at 10, 15, 20, 25 and 30; the y axis is Density with ticks at 0.00, 0.03, 0.06 and 0.09. About nine adjacent bars of similar width span roughly 9 to 32 mg/kg. The tallest bar lies just below the 20 mg/kg mark, a second tall bar sits just above 25 mg/kg, and one bin near the high end between the last two bars is empty. A red smooth bell-shaped curve peaks near the mean and a dotted vertical line crosses the x axis near 20 mg/kg. A small box at upper right reads Mean = 19.8 mg/kg and SD = 5.7. No patient identifiers or individual labels are printed.
